changes.area: Replay checkpoint structure validated at load; damaged checkpoints fall back to an earlier one or the seed
Owned capture-server groups follow SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP and exit; odyssey-gpu-split.mjs adopts the owned start/stop
changes.regression_of: 1d52a7d (pass 3): detached groups left the terminal session, so Ctrl+C and hang-up no longer reached the server

integrated_tests.failure_classification: Wall-clock micro-benchmark 'converts a 1024-post field much faster than before' compares two single timings (78.30 ms vs a 75.06 ms bound) while all workers were saturated. The audit branch does not change this test or its source. Rerun alone: 3/3 passes. Not introduced by pass 4.

baseline_vs_introduced: Pass 3 suite: 24,663 passed / 3 skipped (24,666 cases). Pass 4 runs 24,687 cases: 24,683 passed, 3 skipped, 1 load-sensitive timing failure in an unchanged file that passes alone. The 21-case increase matches the added cases.
architecture: All ratchets unchanged and passing; no ceiling raised.

build.note: Node 22 default heap ran out during vite build in this container; rerun with NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144 passed. CI uses Node 24.

process_reproduction.method: Standalone harness in its own process group spawning a fixture HTTP server with plain spawn (pre-pass-3) or spawnOwnedProcess; SIGINT/SIGHUP sent to the harness group, SIGTERM to the harness alone.

pass_4_owned_group.SIGINT: server stopped; harness ended by SIGINT
pass_4_owned_group.SIGHUP: server stopped; harness ended by SIGHUP
pass_4_owned_group.SIGTERM: server stopped; harness ended by SIGTERM

limits: No browser smoke was rerun: pass 4 changes replay checkpoint selection and Node capture tooling only.
POSIX process-group behavior is not native Windows validation; Windows taskkill branches are unchanged.
An uncatchable SIGKILL of a harness still leaves its detached group running.
No GPU sweep, authenticated Steam, physical controller or Windows desktop validation.

independent_review.method: Four independent reviewers read the full production diff 04b0b613..82bc20f by area (persistence/cloud, mode/replay lifecycle, UI/events/multiplayer, Electron/tooling), given code and baseline only. About 2,500 focused test runs (some overlapping), plus replay round-trip simulations and checks against repository data.
independent_review.verdict: Each area judged safe to merge; most changes fix real bugs, the rest harmless hardening.

fixed.finding: Local Odyssey load dropped well-formed 0-star clears (pass 2 policy); now kept on local load, cloud 1-3 rule unchanged
Rule-refused checkpoint left a seek stuck; pause, scrub, play froze the replay (pre-existing on main)
fixed.note: d741361 first restarted the loop at seek end, which broke two existing demo-seek-performance cases in the full suite; b58561c moved the restart into resumePlayback and restored them.

fixed.finding: focus-pause.js read the wrong runtime-event shape (same bug fixed in main.js)
fixed.note: existing test corrected to the shape electron/main.js sends

fixed.finding: Spectator chat relay duplicated messages to a peer on both rosters
Pass-4 signal forwarding replaced Electron's clean quit, could be disabled by a second module copy, and rethrew EPERM
fixed.electron_check: Electron 44.9.3 under xvfb: SIGINT, SIGTERM and SIGHUP each produced before-quit and exit (code 0) and stopped the owned server; before the fix Electron ended by the raw signal with no before-quit.

left_as_minor: Invitation acceptance re-checks busy state at click time
Snapshot send-rate state resets per round
Mode-manager stop guard treats an empty slot as a replacement (no caller reaches it)
Theoretical PID reuse when signalling an emptied group
Command-line GPU gate ignores a local scene filter; one GPU coverage test is tautological
Quitting during a brand-new cloud's first full upload leaves later files unqueued until their next save

integrated_tests.superseded_run: At 6632a88 the suite had 2 failures in tests/unit/demo-seek-performance.test.js caused by d741361; fixed in b58561c.

independent_review.gates: typecheck, ts/lint/architecture ratchets (unchanged baselines), boundaries, theme lifecycle, release (development), perf budgets, whitespace; build with NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144 (entry 3 chunks / 12 KB, main 4 chunks / 1,308 KB), boot closure, IP strings and Pages artifact all passed
